numerical_contracts.cuda_authority: quantile.cu:571-586 launches in-place neighboring rank reads/writes without ordering. A row can observe repaired or unrepaired predecessor ranks.
numerical_contracts.metal_behavior: metal_histogram.metal:7321 repairs left-to-right within each column, carrying repaired predecessor minima/maxima and enforcing rmax >= rmin+wmin.
numerical_contracts.comparison: Existing exact bitwise summary fixtures check the selected deterministic equations and documented neighbor policy; they cannot establish the winner of a CUDA read/write race.
numerical_contracts.required_action: Keep neighbor-chain divergence fixtures and explicit left-to-right policy. VERIFY-2 should characterize source scheduling rather than claim a unique CUDA race result.

numerical_contracts.operation: Sketch FP32 raw prefixes and duplicate reverse scan association
numerical_contracts.cuda_authority: CUDA quantile sketch FP32 scans and quantile.cu:418 inclusive_scan_by_key reverse duplicate accumulation preserve source term types but use parallel association.
numerical_contracts.metal_behavior: Raw prefixes use a documented256-entry hierarchical FP32 scan; metal_histogram.metal:7252 reverse-scans each pruned column serially, with source duplicate predicate and FP32 operation boundaries.
numerical_contracts.comparison: Existing64 native cases/229976 exact summary fields and Python source oracle validate chosen Metal association; the Python oracle explicitly models that hierarchical association. Exact agreement with that oracle is not CUB/NVIDIA agreement.
numerical_contracts.required_action: Retain exact source-term/duplicate/partition fixtures and non-associative divergence witnesses; compare same summaries on actual NVIDIA under VERIFY-2 without claiming universal bitwise output.

evidence_scope.coverage: 42 inventory families, 109 original CUDA source roots, 1078 lexical line-sites, plus manually traced semantic operations. Helpers, declarations, backend support and unused wrappers are distinguished from consumers.
evidence_scope.limits: All listed sites have dispositions; unlisted branches/operations may still contain defects. No NVIDIA runtime, cross-Apple-hardware or new performance evidence. Classification does not fix open tasks.
